Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects eligible veterans, service members, and reservists pursuing approved apprenticeship or on-job training programs instead of college degrees.
dimensions.evidence: eliminate those provisions relating to veterans educational assistance that disadvantage eligible individuals who choose to pursue programs of apprenticeship

dimensions.assessment: Increases housing stipends and monthly educational allowance rates to full standard levels for qualifying participants.
dimensions.evidence: a monthly housing stipend equal to the monthly amount of the basic allowance for housing... for a member with dependents in pay grade E-5

dimensions.assessment: Modifies benefit payment percentages and housing stipend formulas across multiple educational assistance programs, implying increased benefit disbursements.
dimensions.evidence: is 100 percent of the monthly educational assistance allowance otherwise payable to such individual under this chapter.

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 and title 10 regarding Post-9/11 educational assistance, the All-Volunteer Force program, and Selected Reserve assistance.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, and title 10, United States Code, to eliminate those provisions relating to veterans educational assistance

dimensions.assessment: Provides permanent statutory changes to veterans' educational assistance benefits.

missing_information: Total number of individuals currently enrolled in apprenticeship or on-job training programs.
Total net cost of increasing housing stipends and benefit percentages.
importance_detail.rationale: Removes provisions under multiple educational assistance programs that disadvantaged veterans choosing apprenticeships or on-job training over college degrees, setting housing stipends and benefit rates to 100 percent and providing construction industry attendance waivers.
